name: Bress

attributes.attribute: an alternate spelling of the name Bres

text: Bress is an alternate spelling of the name Bres. The two forms point to the same hero of Irish legend. A reader who meets Bress should turn to the entry on Bres for the fuller account. That entry tells of the fallen king who lost his high seat through the sharp verse of a poet.

okr.objective: Note that Bress is a variant form of the name Bres.
key_results: Bress and Bres name the same hero.
The fuller account sits under the spelling Bres.
